headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 3rd**
article:
The Philadelphia Phillies continued their winning streak, shutting out the Baltimore Orioles 8-0. Tim Mayza earned the win after 2.0 IP of relief work. In other news, the St. Louis Cardinals secured a 5-1 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Jordan Walker leading the offense.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Dalton Rushing of the Los Angeles Dodgers, who was placed on the 10-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation. The Arizona Diamondbacks also transferred Zac Gallen to the 60-day injured list with the same issue. Other notable injuries include Shawn Armstrong of the Cleveland Guardians, Mitch Keller of the Pittsburgh Pirates, Connor Seabold of the Kansas City Royals, PJ Poulin of the Washington Nationals, Jake Fraley of the Tampa Bay Rays, and Lenyn Sosa of the Toronto Blue Jays.

The Philadelphia Phillies made a trade, sending RHP Seth Johnson to the Athletics in exchange for RF Colby Thomas. The Miami Marlins also made several trades, acquiring RHP Brandan Bidois, LF Brian Sanchez, and IF Hyun Seung Lee from the Pittsburgh Pirates in exchange for RHP Lake Bachar. Additionally, the Colorado Rockies traded RHP Victor Vodnik to the Miami Marlins for 1B Connor Norby and RHP Aiden May.

top_news.title: **Phillies Shut Out Orioles 8-0**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies dominated the Baltimore Orioles, securing an 8-0 victory. Tim Mayza earned the win after 2.0 IP of relief work.

top_news.title: **Nationals Fall Short in Atlanta**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals dropped a 2-4 decision to the Atlanta Braves, unable to overcome a strong Braves performance. Mike Yastrzemski led the Nationals with a home run and two RBIs, but it wasn't enough to secure a win.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Take Down Blue Jays 5-1**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals secured a 5-1 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Jordan Walker leading the offense. Walker collected 2 hits, 2 RBIs, and was instrumental in a key play that saw Blaze Jordan and Lars Nootbaar score.

top_news.title: **Diamondbacks Fall to Guardians in Shutout**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians dominated the Arizona Diamondbacks 5-0, securing a shutout victory. Patrick Bailey led the Diamondbacks with a home run and an RBI, while Gavin Williams pitched 5.2 innings with 10 strikeouts and no earned runs for the Guardians.

top_news.title: **Phillies Take Down Nationals 6-3**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies secured a 6-3 win over the Washington Nationals, with Colby Thomas contributing to the team's success. Impact hitters for the Nationals included Abimelec Ortiz, Keibert Ruiz, Daylen Lile, and Bryce Harper, while Derek Hill also made an impact.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Rout Yankees 13-7 in Dominant Performance**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals secured a convincing 13-7 victory over the New York Yankees, with multiple players contributing to the team's high-scoring win. Impact hitters for the Cardinals included Jordan Walker, Alec Burleson, Nathan Church, José Fermín, Jimmy Crooks, and Cam Schlittler, who also had a standout performance on the mound.

top_news.title: **Dalton Rushing Placed on 10-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Los Angeles Dodgers catcher Dalton Rushing has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation. The move was made on August 3, 2026.

top_news.title: **Athletics Acquire RHP Seth Johnson in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies traded RHP Seth Johnson to the Athletics in exchange for RF Colby Thomas. The trade was completed on August 3, 2026.
